text:
Type: textured woven throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: nubby woven fabric
Colors: light warm grey, off-white
Shape: square, small checked weave forming diagonal lines meeting in an X at the center, raised texture, knife edges, medium size
Feel: calm, soft, subtle
Goes with: white and grey sofas, light wood, black accents; Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Texture Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Grey
product.description: The light gray field of this beautiful modern throw pillow is studded with sequin-like circles of white yarn that form a stylish asymmetrical chevron pattern that meets in the middle to create an “X” shape. Cotton/polyester Imported 18"L x 18"W The zipper on this pillow is placed on the back. It has a machine-woven base with added texture and a luxe handfeel. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
